preToolUse.command: python -c "import os, runpy, sys; a = [os.path.abspath(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR') or os.getcwd())]; [a.append(os.path.dirname(a[-1])) for _ in range(64) if os.path.dirname(a[-1]) != a[-1]]; m = [p for p in (os.path.join(x, '.coderig', 'guard.py') for x in a) if os.path.isfile(p)]; sys.argv = [m[0] if m else '', '--agent', 'copilot']; m and runpy.run_path(m[0], run_name='__main__')"

agentStop.command: python -c "import os, runpy, sys; a = [os.path.abspath(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR') or os.getcwd())]; [a.append(os.path.dirname(a[-1])) for _ in range(64) if os.path.dirname(a[-1]) != a[-1]]; m = [p for p in (os.path.join(x, '.coderig', 'verify.py') for x in a) if os.path.isfile(p)]; sys.argv = [m[0] if m else '', '--stop', '--agent', 'copilot']; m and runpy.run_path(m[0], run_name='__main__')"
